about.dashboard: Greeting and a way into every area you can use.
about.modules: Modules installed on this server: permissions, events, jobs, migrations.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with an account of the Autoxide server.
login.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
login.mfaExpired: The sign-in step expired. Sign in again.
login.unreachable: The Autoxide server does not answer. Try again in a moment.
login.deleted: Your account was deleted and you were signed out.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Modules installed in this server, in start order. Modules are compiled into the server: installing or removing one means rebuilding it.
modules.name: Name
modules.pendingHint: Run `autoxide migrate up` on the server to apply pending migrations.

errors.forbidden: Your account lacks the permission `{permission}`. Ask an administrator to give it to one of your roles.
errors.failed: The page could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that the Autoxide server is running.

shell.home: Autoxide admin, go to the overview
shell.searchPlaceholder: Find a page or an area…
shell.noMatch: No page matches. Try the name of an area, such as "modules".

dashboard.description: Every area you can use on this server. Areas appear here once their module is installed and your role grants their permission.
dashboard.nothing: No area is available to you yet. Ask an administrator to add a role with the permissions you need.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, how you sign in, the devices signed in to your account, and your data. You do all of this yourself; nobody has to approve it.

form.fix: {count, plural, one {One field needs fixing.} other {# fields need fixing.}}

required.name: Give the passkey a name, up to 100 characters.
required.confirm_email: Type your email address to confirm.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: To change your display name, ask an administrator.
profile.unverifiedHint: Open the link in the verification mail to confirm this address.

email.sent: A verification mail is on its way to {email}.
email.changeIntro: The verification mail goes to the NEW address. Your email changes only when you open its link within 24 hours; until then the current address stays in use.

password.title: Password
password.meta: Changing it signs out every other device.
password.intro: Every other device is signed out; you stay signed in here. Several wrong current passwords lock sign-in for this email for a while.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices must sign in again.

totp.title: Two-step sign-in (authenticator app)
totp.onMeta: Sign-in asks for a code from your app. {remaining, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}.
totp.offMeta: Add a 6-digit code from an app such as an authenticator to every sign-in.
totp.lowCodes: {remaining, plural, =0 {No recovery code left.} one {Only # recovery code left.} other {Only # recovery codes left.}} Make new ones before you lose your phone.
totp.enableIntro: You will scan a code with your authenticator app, then type the code the app shows.
totp.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
totp.newCodesIntro: Ten new codes replace the old ones; the old ones stop working.
totp.codesReplaced: New recovery codes made; the old ones no longer work.
totp.disableIntro: Your remaining recovery codes are deleted. Signing in then needs only your password or a passkey.

codes.once: These codes are shown only this once. Each works once in place of a code from the app, for example after losing your phone. Store them somewhere safe, away from the phone.
codes.label: Recovery codes
codes.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Download the codes or write them down.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.about: A passkey signs you in with the fingerprint, face or PIN of a device, and cannot be phished like a password.
passkeys.addIntro: Your browser then asks for the fingerprint, face or PIN of this device, or of a security key.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: To recognize it later, for example "Work laptop".
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey was not created: the request was cancelled or timed out.
passkeys.exists: This device already holds a passkey for your account.
passkeys.failed: The browser could not create the passkey. Try again.
passkeys.removeIntro: It stops working at once. Delete it from the device as well.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.about: See a device you do not know? Sign it out, then change your password.
sessions.ended: Signed out. That device must sign in again.
sessions.endOthersIntro: {count, plural, one {The other device} other {All # other devices}} must sign in again. You stay signed in here. A device signed out can keep working until its current access expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.endedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other device was signed in.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}
sessions.useSignOut: This is the session you are using. Sign out from the account menu instead.
sessions.unknownCurrent: This session is not recognized yet, so it cannot be marked or kept. Sign out and in again, or wait a few minutes.

data.title: My data
data.exportMeta: A JSON file with everything the server keeps about you: profile, roles, sessions, API keys, passkeys, two-step sign-in status, and what each module keeps. Passwords, tokens and keys are never in it.
data.deleteMeta: Deletes your account at once. This cannot be undone.
data.lastAdmin: If you are the last administrator, give the admin role to someone else before deleting your account.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.goesNow: removes your account, sessions, API keys and passkeys at once, and signs you out;
delete.goesLater: removes the data other modules keep for you (notes, files…) shortly after;
delete.mismatch: This is not your email. Type {email} exactly.
